visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of a floor graphic in a subway station, resembling a compass with directions to Haneda and Narita airports. Several people in casual winter clothing walk across the patterned floor. Large pink and white text overlays are centered on the screen. (2) The scene cuts to a subway platform where commuters stand waiting. Digital departure boards hang from the ceiling, displaying schedules in Japanese and English. A silver train with a green stripe slowly pulls into the station from the left as people remain stationary on the platform. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a yellow-and-white station map mounted on a wall. The map illustrates train tracks, station levels, and exit paths. Various icons and bilingual labels indicate nearby landmarks like Sengaku-ji Temple. (4) The camera shows a train door closing from the inside. Outside, the station platform and a large digital sign are visible. The final sequence transitions to a full-screen graphic featuring a pink QR code in the center, followed by a brand logo with social media handles for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a practical travel guide for tourists in Tokyo, specifically highlighting the importance of knowing elevator exit locations on the Toei Asakusa Line for airport transfers. It provides a visual walkthrough of station layouts and offers a downloadable resource via QR code to solve the potential inconvenience of taking the wrong exit.
